content.comment_body: Hello community and experts, I am facing an issue: We set up VPN and the [product_name], and I can easily download/upload programs using [product_name] Soft Comfort (LSC). Accessing the device’s web server via VPN also works. I’ve created a custom web page with [product_name] Web Editor (LWE), and want to upload it to the device, but the LWE software will not connect. The connection attempt just stays at "Connecting" and never finishes or shows any errors. So, is it possible to upload a custom web page to the [product_name] remotely using VPN? Device version: [article_no] Firmware: [version_no] LSC: [version_no] LWE: [version_no]
Hi, As far as I know, uploading an LWE project works only on local networks or through an MSD card. Hope this helps.

Hi, That's unfortunate, but I'm still hopeful. I tried using Wireshark to monitor the network. When uploading programs from LSC, I can see traffic between my PC and the device, but when trying to use LWE, there is no network activity directed to the device’s IP at all. Could it be that the LWE software on my setup is malfunctioning and doesn’t even attempt communication? I find it puzzling why uploading via VPN shouldn’t work, since it's technically the same network. Is uploading remotely to the device’s external IP with specific ports opened (like LSC’s ‘Connect through: Dynamic DNS’ option) also unsupported in LWE? Any ideas or suggestions would be greatly appreciated.
Thanks for splitting, but it's essentially the same problem.

One method is to use remote desktop access with software like TeamViewer. You can transfer and upload the LWE project from a remote PC to the device on the same LAN, but the remote PC also needs to have LWE installed.
Hi everyone, Has anyone managed to solve this? I'm experiencing the same problem.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report being unable to upload custom web pages to the [product_name] device via VPN using [product_name] Web Editor. Although [product_name] Soft Comfort can connect over VPN, LWE fails to do so and only displays an endless 'Connecting' message with no error feedback. Users are puzzled by this difference in behavior and suspect network or software restrictions. The primary concern is the lack of clear communication and feedback from LWE, especially since similar remote transfers via VPN work with other tools.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the ability to upload custom web pages to the [product_name] device remotely via VPN, just as they do with [product_name] Soft Comfort, as well as clearer status and error indications from [product_name] Web Editor.
